note: Ohio County's 500-acre park about 2 miles from Hartford: park lake, ball fields, arena, trap range and event halls. Two furnished campers for rent. Weekly and monthly stays are offered, and many rigs look long-term. --Claude
summary: Kept (local, no price gate). County page: $39.95-59.50 nightly, 30/50A W/E and full hookup, year round, no reservations (first come), no year-round residence. Google 4.0/47. Imagery shows a packed long-stay-looking cluster; nightly share not measurable. Pin ~400 m off -> 37.4583,-86.8672.
flags: PIN: stored 37.46174,-86.86632 is ~400 m north of the campground, by the barns on the park road. RVs sit in a cluster at ~37.4583,-86.8670 and along the loop west of it (Google's point 37.46024,-86.86695 is at the park's north side, also off). Suggest location -> 37.4583,-86.8672.
